verdict.rationale: Runtime probes confirm a live llms.txt that indexes the full docs tree (build, platform and API reference) and documents that every docs page mirrors as markdown at URL + .mdx. A follow-up probe confirmed the quickstart .mdx mirror returns clean markdown, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is also served. Missing for 10: no evidence of a consolidated full-content file (e.g. llms-full.txt), the /docs.md path returns 404, and there is no independent community corroboration of agents consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
